mentions.name: Taskusanakirja
mentions.description: This TUI and CLI Finnish-to-English dictionary provides instant search-as-you-type lookups, packaged as a single standalone executable for Windows, Mac and Linux. It is optimized for speed and can lemmatize even heavily inflected words, with an optional paid database download for Taskusanakirja Pro.
mentions.problem: Learners of Finnish commonly stumble on heavily inflected words, and the tool addresses this with lemmatization that few other dictionaries offer.
mentions.audience: any learner of the Finnish language
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm releasing an actually instant search-to-type TUI and CLI Finnish to English dictionary called Taskusanakirja (pocket dictionary).
